seoTitle: How to Send an Invoice on eBay as a Seller
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to sending a buyer invoice on eBay from Seller Hub, including how to adjust shipping, apply discounts, and add a message.
intro: Sending an invoice on eBay helps sellers finalize a sale, combine shipping, or apply a discount before a buyer pays. This guide walks through the Sold section in Seller Hub, adjusting charges, and sending the invoice so payment goes smoothly.

steps.heading: Go to the Sold section
steps.body: Open eBay Seller Hub and navigate to the Sold section to see items awaiting payment or invoicing.

steps.heading: Select the item or items
steps.body: Choose a single item or select multiple items from the same buyer if you're offering combined postage.

steps.heading: Click Send Invoice
steps.body: Once your items are selected, use the Send Invoice option to open the invoice editor.

steps.heading: Adjust shipping and discounts
steps.body: Update the shipping fee or apply a discount for combined items before finalizing the invoice.

steps.heading: Add a message for the buyer
steps.body: Include a short note if needed, such as confirming shipping arrangements or thanking them for their purchase.

steps.heading: Send and track the invoice
steps.body: After sending, the invoice becomes part of eBay's payment system, and you can track whether it's been paid.

faq.question: Why would I send an invoice on eBay?
faq.answer: Sellers send invoices to combine postage, adjust shipping charges, apply discounts, or finalize a sale before the buyer pays.

faq.question: Can I combine multiple items into one invoice?
faq.answer: Yes, you can select multiple items from the same buyer in Seller Hub and send them as a single combined invoice.

faq.question: Can I edit an invoice after sending it?
faq.answer: Yes, invoices can typically be modified if the buyer hasn't paid yet, allowing you to adjust shipping or pricing.

faq.question: What happens if the buyer doesn't pay the invoice?
faq.answer: Unpaid invoices can lead to an unpaid item case, so it's worth following up if payment doesn't come through.

faq.question: Does sending an invoice work the same on mobile?
faq.answer: The core steps are the same, though the exact layout may differ slightly between the eBay website and mobile app.
